method: Read-only production source and fixture-manifest inspection; no build, native execution, fixture generation or runtime test.
authority_boundary: Operational findings against the existing ratified S5A requirements, not a replacement specification or execution authorization. PM023/026, UVT and the complete C01 contract remain controlling. Other product lanes and Claude prototypes are untouched.

findings.observed: SelectionTarget has four variants: None, ReviewAction(String), AuthoredObject(String), CheckFinding(String). DatumSelectionContext has only kind:String and id:Option<String> and maps those four variants.
findings.gap: The ratified nine-kind model, typed Object classes, Compound/focus, Run origin, semantic Net/Bus and revision-derived membership are not represented by these types. The committed specification repair does not implement them.

findings.observed: Primary pointer dispatch routes schematic world coordinates to resolve_schematic_primary_click. That function performs schematic_world_hit, logs a trace and returns false without selection dispatch. Board retained hits reach select_hit_target.
findings.gap: Schematic coordinate/hit infrastructure is reusable, but this production branch cannot count as native schematic selection. C01 must bind both surface paths to the same successor model, not report board-only execution as complete.
findings.existing_authority: S5A-C01 complete board/schematic scope; UVT shared-backbone law

findings.observed: select_authored_object checks board scene collections and writes one AuthoredObject string; a missing id returns false. This function does not implement compound membership or derived-subject re-resolution.
findings.gap: The successor needs ratified acquisition and lifetime semantics. Incoming stale identities and per-revision drop/report/no-resurrection must not be inferred from the singleton function returning false.

findings.observed: Inspector dispatch matches singleton SelectionTarget and its component branch formats coordinates using {:.2}, {:.2} mm and division by 1_000_000. Terminal launch context uses DatumSelectionContext::from_selection; click handlers emit separate textual console echoes.
findings.gap: These inspected paths do not provide the required shared compound projection or unit-aware typed Common/Mixed/Unavailable aggregates. The hardcoded component position presentation is a concrete integration site, not authorization to change Global Preferences.

findings.observed: The selection cache key varies by selected object except specified lightweight cases. SelectionChanged can call invalidate_scene_for_session_change or invalidate_scene rather than only invalidate_frame.
findings.gap: This is a remaining retained-scene invalidation path. It is not proof of the ratified zero-retained-resolve/reupload invariant; runtime buffer and CAM measurements remain required. The inspection alone does not quantify actual GPU uploads.

findings.observed: Editor Escape first dispatches CancelAuthoringGesture, then ClearSelection. The workspace character dispatcher supplies tool/focus/review actions but no Ctrl+A action in this table.
findings.gap: Existing focus and cancellation dispatch are reuse points, not proof of ratified marquee cancellation, additive/subtractive membership, keyboard-only acquisition or selection-specific accessibility. A global absence of Ctrl+A is not inferred from one table.

findings.observed: The shared viewport exports camera, grid, hit index and interaction infrastructure. Its module inventory does not expose a selection or region module; the inspected hit API exposes point hit_test.
findings.gap: Reuse the existing shared infrastructure where applicable, but do not equate a point hit index with complete bounded exact rectangle/lasso qualification. Full A1-A7 and class-matrix evidence remains unestablished.

findings.observed: The inspected native validation manifest lists seven project-validation fixtures, including intentionally invalid projects. The draft S5A contract still has unresolved fixture/input closure, pending dispatch keys and null handlers.
findings.gap: These are not yet an approved complete selection fixture corpus. Exact per-class native identities, 100k maximal-collision population, input/state capture, environment and measurement budgets are not established by this manifest. No fixture absence elsewhere in the repository is asserted.

scenario_disposition.S5A-S01: Not ready: native schematic dispatch, typed acquisition and full exact marquee/class cases need implementation and evidence bindings.
scenario_disposition.S5A-S02: Not ready: complete typed revision/lifecycle cases and identity observations need binding; do not substitute generic refused-or-cleared behavior for the ratified drop/report law.
scenario_disposition.S5A-S03: Not ready: pane focus exists, but complete identity/projection/filter cases and overlay invariants remain unproven.
scenario_disposition.S5A-S04: Not ready: singleton Inspector/context paths do not satisfy shared compound output or units-aware fields.
scenario_disposition.S5A-S05: Not ready: inspected selection handlers are consumer-state paths, but complete source/journal/undo/reopen native evidence is still missing.
scenario_disposition.S5A-S06: Not ready: complete keyboard/non-color/native accessibility and approved dense performance evidence are not established.

preserved_scope: All required board and schematic classes and the nine PM026 subject kinds remain required.
Definition-editor obligations in the UVT class matrix are not silently deleted by this inspection; exact consumer timing must be reconciled in the full packet.
Board dimensions and hierarchical sheets retain their ratified deferrals and tracked re-entry conditions.
Selection/inspection stays read-only; movement, placement, property mutation and GUI write-path delivery are not added.
No product enrollment, reviewer reservation or owner acceptance is manufactured.
conclusion: C01 is still in progress. This audit supplies exact current production reuse/gap evidence for replacing placeholder consumer bindings; it does not complete the six unresolved C01 questions.
